historical_scope.title: PINAX IV. Iambica Euripedaea penultima longa.

verification.method: Independent direct visual comparison of three separate 1650 public-domain digitizations. Rperm03 was selected because its six signs are materially clearer than the unresolved augmentation punctus in Rperm01.
verification.independence_note: Canonical status rests on agreement of directly inspected primary images. Machine OCR and modern transcriptions were not used as data authority.

claims: The integers encode only the relative mensural ratio minim=1 and semibreve=2.
No MIDI quarter-note duration is asserted.

relationship_to_rperm01.note: Rperm01 remains unresolved and is not superseded. Choosing a different, directly legible historical row avoids manufacturing certainty about its first augmentation punctus.

limits: This record verifies one six-sign duple rhythm series from Pinax IV.
It does not assign modern tempo, BPM, beat-unit semantics, or MIDI timing.
It does not resolve the first-sign augmentation punctus in Rperm01.
